{{Quote|And if you turn me into a vegetable, you shoot me. Deal?"''<br />''"Deal.|[[Arla Fett]] and [[Bardan Jusik]]|<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
A '''persistent vegetative state''' was a condition of patients with severe brain damage in whom [[Coma/Legends|coma]] has progressed to a state of wakefulness without detectable awareness. A good example of this is the case of Tay Vanis, a rebel who, after being tortured by Darth Vader, was left in a vegetative state of mentality.
